images.title: Five slots, ten choices each
images.purpose: Shows a 5-digit lock as five slots with 10 choices each, giving 10⁵ = 100000 passwords.
images.composition: Plain white background, the main object large and centred with wide empty margins, no scenery, no characters, no extra decoration. One row of five tall rounded slots, like the windows of a combination lock, with a brace above.
images.exact_structure: One row of five equal tall rounded rectangles with teal (#0072B2) outlines and no text inside, evenly spaced like the windows of a lock. Above them an amber (#E69F00) brace labelled 10 choices each. Below them the label 10⁵ = 100000 in reddish purple (#CC79A7), and under that the small label 00000 to 99999. Exactly 5 slots. Nothing else.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: Each slot multiplies the count by 10, so 5 slots give 10⁵ passwords.
images.description: Shows a 5-digit lock as five slots with 10 choices each, giving 10⁵ = 100000 passwords.

image_decisions.why: Seeing the slots side by side shows why each new digit multiplies, not adds, the count.
